_doc: QC metric definitions. Edit thresholds here; no code changes needed. Only 'functional' can FAIL a run; every other category only WARNs.

release_gate.note: Suite passes the release gate when at least this share of runs pass functionally.

responsive.note: Each viewport with horizontal overflow costs an equal share of the score.

performance.standard: Google Core Web Vitals / Lighthouse 'good' and 'poor' limits
performance.note: Lab measurement from the test machine; run with --workers 1 for stable numbers.

visual_quality.note: Judge-assessed (LLM): wrong/missing images, overlaps, misalignment, wrong labels. Subjective; treat as a warning.

regression.note: Only scored when run with --baseline compare. Weight is 0 by default (informational).
